bio.text: Dr. Annie Andrews, a pediatrician in Charleston, won the Democratic nomination for U.S. Senate in South Carolina in the June 9, 2026 primary, defeating Brandon Brown and Kyle Freeman.
She previously ran for Congress in 2022 as the Democratic candidate against U.S. Rep. Nancy Mace and was unsuccessful.
